data.body: **[P1] Retry a not-yet-created log group before failing.** With `wait_seconds=0`, the first `FilterLogEvents` request runs immediately. On a fresh Lambda deployment, the auto-created log group may still return `ResourceNotFoundException`; `get_log_events` wraps this in `CloudWatchLogError`, bypassing the polling budget and potentially aborting the run. Retry this error as an empty poll until the deadline while continuing to raise non-retryable errors, and add a test where initial not-found responses are followed by logs.
